This exam uses High Security (Strict Mode), which requires the 'Screen Pinning' feature to prevent you from switching to other applications.

Your phone's navigation is currently set to 'Fullscreen Gestures' (Swipe). Gesture navigation is not supported because it easily allows you to exit the app even when the screen is pinned.

Steps to change it:
1. Tap the 'Open Settings' button below.
2. Find the 'System Navigation' menu.
3. Change the selection from 'Gestures' to 'Buttons' (3-Button Navigation).
4. Once changed, please return to this app to start the exam.
This exam uses Strict Security. The app requires the \'Display over other apps\' permission to lock the screen and prevent cheating.\n\nPlease enable this permission on the next settings screen.
